name: Pan-Fried Sole with Mashed Potatoes & Green Beans

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg green beans
6 medium yellow potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Peel the potatoes, then halve lengthwise and crosswise; transfer the quarters to a small saucepan. Cover with hot water (from the tap) by about 2 ½ cm and bring to a boil over high heat.
Trim and discard the ends of the green beans, then halve the green beans. Transfer to a medium bowl.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce the heat to medium and cook until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife, 8 to 12 minutes. Once done, reserve about 1 ½ cup of liquid and drain the rest. Cover the saucepan to keep warm.
Add butter to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
Pat the sole dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sole fillets
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add the sole; cook until it is cooked through and golden brown, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Once the sole has been transferred, add the green beans to the skillet and pour in ⅓ cup of water. Bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, cook until bright green, 2 to 3 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, butter, salt, and pepper to the green beans. Cook until the water is fully evaporated, another 1 to 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp butter, unsalted
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add ½ of the reserved liquid, butter, salt, and pepper to the potatoes; mash with a potato masher until smooth. Add more liquid to thin out the mash if needed.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the mashed potatoes, green beans, and sole between plates. Enjoy!
